briefs.title: Sold Out — The Empty Tray
briefs.prompt: Shot from a low three-quarter angle across a shop counter, 80mm f/2.8. A shallow pine display tray, edges darkened from years of butter, lined with parchment that is now stained in nine oily circles where the rolls sat. Only crumbs, flakes of crust and a scatter of coarse salt remain. A pair of worn stainless tongs lies diagonally across the tray, jaws open, entering from the lower-right corner. Behind, softly out of focus, a folded linen cloth and an empty paper bag stack. The tray is pushed to the right third; the counter top is oiled oak with cup rings. Late-morning window light from the left rakes across the parchment so the grease stains glow faintly amber. Editorial still-life photography, one cohesive series, shot on medium format with a 80mm lens. Color grading: warm neutral base, a single accent hue close to #b45309, low saturation, no neon. Lighting: soft directional window light from the left, bright and airy, gentle long shadows, no flash. Texture: fine film grain, matte surfaces, shallow depth of field on the subject only. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
briefs.negative: sold-out sign or any written notice, price tags, hands, customers, people, full tray of bread, clean new parchment, centred tray, sterile white studio counter, flash, neon, cool blue grading, watermark, border

briefs.title: Four A.M. Rack — First Bake Cooling
briefs.prompt: Camera at tabletop height, 80mm f/2.8, focus on the second roll from the front. A scratched steel cooling rack sits in the lower-right two-thirds, holding nine salt breads; the nearest one is cut by the bottom edge of the frame. One roll at the back is a shade too dark on its heel. Cultured butter has leaked from the bases and re-set into amber pools on crumpled baking parchment, translucent at the edges. Coarse salt crystals scattered unevenly, a few fallen through the rack onto the raw plywood work bench. Window light rakes from the left, throwing long soft shadows of the rack bars across the parchment. Bench shows flour smudges and an old knife score. Editorial still-life photography, one cohesive series, shot on medium format with a 80mm lens. Color grading: warm neutral base, a single accent hue close to #b45309, low saturation, no neon. Lighting: soft directional window light from the left, bright and airy, gentle long shadows, no flash. Texture: fine film grain, matte surfaces, shallow depth of field on the subject only. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
briefs.negative: hands, bakers, people, text or lettering on parchment or packaging, logos, glossy CGI butter, perfectly uniform rolls, centred symmetric arrangement, flash highlights, neon colours, dark moody grading, oven interior, watermark, border
